title: Microsoft Teams panels: hide the organiser name in Calendar View
summary: The briefing's default, licensing, rollout dates and device-management behaviour are supported by Microsoft's notice, roadmap and documentation. The portal routes are correct but stop before selecting the setting; these are minor navigation omissions, not reasons to withhold publication.

claims.claim: Teams panels gain a new Show organizer name administrator setting.
claims.quote: Admins can now decide whether the organizer’s name will appear in the calendar. They can toggle the “Show organizer name” setting On or Off in the Pro Management portal or on their local device settings.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Turning Show organizer name off hides the organiser's name in Calendar View on the panel.
claims.quote: Depending on the selection, the organizer’s name will either be displayed or hidden in the calendar view.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Admins can configure Show organizer name in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: Admins can toggle the Show organizer name setting ON or OFF in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or on the panel device.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Admins can configure Show organizer name directly on a Teams panel device.
claims.quote: They can toggle the “Show organizer name” setting On or Off in the Pro Management portal or on their local device settings.

claims.claim: Teams panels are touchscreen devices mounted outside meeting spaces.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams panels are the compact touchscreen devices that are mounted right outside of your meeting spaces, typically next to entrances.

claims.claim: The Learn page describes the Home screen scheduled-meeting tile as showing the organiser's name.
claims.quote: It displays meeting title in prominent text, meeting start and end times, and meeting organizer's name.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether Show organizer name also affects the Home screen meeting tile.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name setting Teams admin settings Meetings calendar home screen. Opened devices-release-notes and use-teams-panels; the setting's description names calendar view, not the scheduled-meeting tile.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Changing device settings in the Pro Management portal, including the table's single-device and bulk controls, requires Rooms Management RBAC permissions.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones), provided you have the necessary role-based access control permissions for Rooms Management.

claims.claim: A portal-initiated device setting change is applied as a job rather than in real time.
claims.quote: Since setting changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to the Teams device aren't in real-time, there will be a delay.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Apply Now queues a settings job and restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Schedule Later applies the settings change during the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: A settings job can fail with DEVICE IN MEETING.
claims.quote: Failed | DEVICE IN MEETING | Device is currently in a meeting. | Try again later.

claims.claim: A settings job can fail if the device is disconnected when execution is attempted.
claims.quote: Failed | DEVICE DISCONNECTED | Device was disconnected when we attempted to execute the settings change, so no changes occurred.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Portal settings management is available only for signed-in devices.
claims.quote: Settings management is available only for signed-in devices. Ensure that the device is signed in for settings changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to be applied successfully.

claims.claim: Settings changed directly on a device are synchronised back to the portal.
claims.quote: Any setting changes made directly on the device are synchronized back to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal and reflected in the Settings tab of the device panel

claims.claim: The single-device settings route in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal is Rooms/ Phones > device > Settings.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. Select the Settings tab in the device panel. Use the left navigation in the device panels to browse settings categories
claims.fix: Keep the documented path, but append to controls[0].note: 'This route stops at the Settings tab; browse the settings categories and select Show organizer name. Microsoft has not published which category contains it.' The cited page documents browsing categories and modifying settings, not the final category.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell, Graph or other API operation that sets Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name PowerShell Microsoft Graph API; Teams module ShowOrganizerName. Opened Graph teamworkDeviceConfiguration and Update-MgBetaTeamworkDeviceConfiguration references; no organiser-display property is documented.

claims.claim: The bulk device settings route in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal is Settings > Device Settings > Jobs.
claims.quote: go to Settings > Device Settings. Select the Jobs tab. Add devices or groups of devices where the setting changes are to be applied. Select Settings changes to be applied to devices.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path to 'Settings > Device Settings > Jobs > Settings'. Append to controls[1].note: 'On Jobs, add the target devices or groups of devices, then select the Settings changes to apply.' This follows the cited Create a Job steps without implying that this particular setting is documented for bulk changes.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no equivalent script or API for creating the bulk device settings job shown in the second row.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management device settings jobs bulk configuration PowerShell Microsoft Graph API; Graph beta teamwork device update configuration settings jobs. Opened pro-portal-settings and Graph configuration references; no bulk settings-job operation found.

claims.claim: Device setting jobs are a general portal control for changing settings on many Teams devices, including panels.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones) ... You can change settings on a single device, or for many devices at once using Device setting jobs.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented which portal settings category holds Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name setting Teams admin settings Meetings calendar home screen. Opened pro-portal-settings, devices-release-notes and device-settings-available; Android's full settings list is coming soon and no category for this setting is given.

claims.claim: The Learn pages do not give the complete on-device route to Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name setting Teams admin settings Meetings calendar home screen. Opened use-teams-panels and devices-release-notes; general Teams admin settings access is documented, but the route to Show organizer name is not.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically confirmed Show organizer name as a setting that bulk jobs can apply.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels Show organizer name PowerShell Microsoft Graph API device settings jobs. Opened pro-portal-settings, devices-release-notes and device-settings-available; jobs are general, but this setting's bulk eligibility is not listed and Android's full list is coming soon.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically confirmed that Show organizer name can be pushed through settings templates.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management device settings jobs bulk configuration PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Read pro-portal-settings template steps, devices-release-notes and device-settings-available; no template eligibility for Show organizer name is stated.

claims.claim: MC1484010 says the available information does not indicate management support through Entra ID group membership.
claims.quote: The available information does not indicate support for management through Entra ID group membership.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The panel's local settings change applies per device, so admins can choose which panels hide organiser names.
claims.quote: Any updates to the Panels App settings done via the device are applicable only to that specific device. Those updates will not impact other panels devices in your organization.
